scope: Proposition 7.4 (Local tilt bounds) of the manuscript “Self-dual random-cluster interfaces below one” (preprints/Self-dual-random-cluster-interfaces-below-one-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 bf15a86507a10184), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 104-105. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix b > 0, and write Fj(b) = EbNj , dνj = Fj(b)−1 bNj dP. There is a constant Cb such that C−1 b ≤ Fj(b)/Fj−1(b) ≤ Cb. (7.4) 104 For every fixed B ≥ 0, sup i≥j Eνj eBXi ≤ Cb,B. (7.5) The assertions hold conditionally on compatible exterior states and allow a fixed additional family of passage counts whose buffers lie at or beyond the tilt level. They also hold with the radial direction reversed, for nests whose raw traces lie outside a moving inner cutoff and inside a fixed outer cutoff.
